office: the Ministry of External Affairs (the Chief Passport Officer and the passport offices)
note: Fees in India from 1 July 2026. A minor of 15 to 18 may apply as an adult, for ten years; a minor's passport is valid five years or until 18, whichever comes first, and an adult's at most ten. Fresh applications (not reissues) for children up to 8 and people over 60 get 10% off. A lost or damaged passport costs more (5000 or 6000; a minor's 4250).
